mentions.name: Dozenal
mentions.description: A puzzle game played with numbers on a board where the gap between two numbers dictates the arithmetic operation applied to them. The goal is to use all the spaces on the board to make sums of 12.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://dozenal.game

It's a puzzle game -- numbers on a board -- where the gap between numbers dictates the arithmetic operation done to them.

The goal is to use all the spaces on the board to make sums of 12.
mentions.author: sarreph
